title: Studying star-forming processes at core and clump scales: the case of the young stellar object G29.862-0.0044
question: What are the core- and clump-scale physical and chemical properties and outflow/jet structure of the massive YSO G29.862-0.0044, from near-IR, ALMA, ASTE and JCMT CO data?

what.value: Bolometric luminosity ~4.5e4 Lsun, scaled to 6.2 kpc

evidence.quote: about $4.5 \times 10^{4}$ L$_{\odot}$ (based on the luminosity of (cite: mottram11) corrected to the assumed distance of 6.2 kpc)

what.value: Dust temperature ~26 K from PPMAP Hi-GAL map

evidence.quote: (T$_{dust} \sim 26$ K) obtained from the dust temperature map

recipe.goal: Extract continuum and line maps from ALMA cubes
recipe.method: Continuum subtraction with imcontsub, integrated line maps, channel maps, 1.3 mm continuum core parameters

recipe.goal: CH3CN rotational diagram for Trot and column density
recipe.method: Gaussian fits to K components, linear fit of rotation diagram
assumptions: LTE, optically thin lines, beam filling factor of unity

recipe.goal: Core gas mass, density and virial mass
recipe.method: Dust continuum mass formula; virial mass from CH3CN width
key_parameters: S = 0.051 Jy, kappa = 0.01 cm2/g, dv = 6.7 km/s, R = 0.01 pc

recipe.goal: Clump-scale gas diagnostics from ASTE and JCMT
recipe.method: Gaussian fits to spectra; HCN/HNC ratio converted to kinetic temperature with Hacar et al. 2020 Eq. 3

evidence.quote: We derive a $T_{rot}$ of about 82 K
we obtain a CH$_3$CN column density of about $10^{15}$ cm$^{-2}$
we obtain T$_{\rm K} \sim 23$ K towards G29-YSO

not_stated_but_needed: ALMA calibration/imaging details (pipeline version, CASA version, weighting, cleaning) for the archival cubes
Continuum image construction and beam/size fitting method
Rest frequencies and line strength values used, and Q_rot value
Flux density measurement aperture/method for core
Gaussian-fit procedure and uncertainties for CH3CN lines
missing_for_reproduction: ASTE and NIRI raw data access
Line fit uncertainties and Qrot value
score_reason: Public ALMA data and simple analyses, but processing and fitting details are sparse and several results lack uncertainties.
rediscovery_reason: Public archival ALMA data with a simple numeric recipe (Trot, mass, virial mass), though some settings are missing.
